newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Garuda rejects advice to ground Airbuses.
newsitem.headline: Garuda rejects advice to ground Airbuses.

text.p: Indonesia's flag carrier Pt Garuda Indonesia said on Tuesday it would continue to fly its Airbus Industrie A330-300 planes powered by Rolls-Royce Trent 700 engines despite advice that it ground them.
But it said it would use other planes for flights to Hong Kong, which banned the Garuda Airbuses after the territory's own airlines grounded theirs because of engine failures.

"There is no significant problem. We will use DC-10s or Boeing 747s to Hong Kong following the instruction from the Hong Kong authority that bans our Airbus A330-300 from flying to Hong Kong," Garuda spokesman Arief Hartanto told Reuters.
"We will continue to operate our six Airbuses on other routes because there is no order to ground that aircraft from the appropriate authority so far," he said.

Hong Kong's Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd and Hong Kong Dragon Airlines (Dragonair) have suspended flights with their Airbus A330-300s powered by Rolls-Royce Trent 700 engines after five engine failures since November.
The Civil Aviation Department of Hong Kong (DCA) said the British Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) had urged Garuda to ground its Trent-700 powered A330-300 fleet.
